title: Product Response Fields
description: Canonical product fields a buyer requests from list_products. Required product_id and name fields are always returned. list_applications also overrides projection whenever a property or collection list is in the effective targeting because it is the decision receipt for seller-specific list matching. targeting_resolution and expires_at override projection whenever the seller returns modifications, as does collection_targeting_allowed whenever returned overlay_support declares collection_list or collection_lists. Legacy named-format fields remain available only through get_products. A projection that omits collections also omits the response-level collections array. On the canonical list_products path, requesting installments also returns collections, because a canonical installment names its collection and canonical-product.json requires the product to declare it. Legacy get_products shares this enum but not that rule: its installment keeps the deprecated single-namespace shorthand, so it can be returned without collections.
